gain_point.note: Non-recursive conversion of Levant's published recursive set (1.1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5) at L = 1: lambda1 = 5, lambda2 = 3*5^(3/4), lambda3 = 2*lambda2^(2/3), lambda4 = (3/2)*sqrt(lambda3), lambda5 = 11/10. lambda2, lambda3 and lambda4 are irrational and enter through rational brackets, so the corner box of this point has 2**3 = 8 corners. levant5d is the n = 5 scale-boundary probe and is NOT part of the 12-system benchmark matrix, so it is registered in the flagship table only; as for levant4d, its module defaults ARE the converted 2003 gains, which is why one entry serves both roles.

provenance.lambda1: system module constant (levant5d.py, _L1 = 5.0) = Levant 2003 print lambdahat4 = 5 at L = 1
provenance.lambda2: system module constant (levant5d.py, _L2 = 3.0*_L1**(3/4)) = Levant 2003 print lambdahat3*lambda1^(3/4); irrational, bracketed by lambda2^4 = 10125
provenance.lambda3: system module constant (levant5d.py, _L3 = 2.0*_L2**(2/3)) = Levant 2003 print lambdahat2*lambda2^(2/3); irrational, bracketed by lambda3^6 = 648000
provenance.lambda4: system module constant (levant5d.py, _L4 = 1.5*_L3**0.5) = Levant 2003 print lambdahat1*lambda3^(1/2); irrational, bracketed by lambda4^12 = 5380840125/64
provenance.lambda5: system module constant (levant5d.py, _L5 = 1.1) = Levant 2003 print lambdahat0 = 1.1 at L = 1

encoding.exact: rational string p/q; gains, delta0, margin and bracket endpoints are never float encoded
encoding.shared_W: the nominal W witness is one capture set under shared_W_grams; each corner carries W_grams_shared: true. Storage only: every corner still proves all 2^n octants against it, from its own gains

coverage.rule: nominal: one dynamics, 2^n octants for V and 2^n for W per corner. perturbed: 2^n for V, and 2 endpoints x 2^n octants per corner.

provenance.note: unverified provenance, not part of the proved statement; the portable verifier ignores every key in this object
provenance.source_claim: an exact PASS at EVERY corner certifies the gain BRACKET BOX at eps_certified, at this m, nominal (delta0 = 0), and nothing else; a FAIL is typed by its reason and its witness path and is NOT a statement that the system admits no certificate

exact_stage.note: the exact phase's OWN reported numbers, kept for audit; the portable verifier derives its own

printed_coefficients.tier: A (same Gram sidecar, byte for byte)
printed_coefficients.note: V's coefficients were rounded to exact dyadic rationals; every other proved field is the source record's. Fields outside 'provenance' that describe the source proof (witness, source_artifacts, env) are the source's and name the Gram's origin, not this V's margin; this V's margin is the one VC derives (and, in a final record, declares).
printed_coefficients.declared_margin_source: exact residual screen (eps * (1 - max ||E||_1/eps)); VC accepts it only if it equals the margin VC derives

verifier.acceptance_rule: charge < eps (strict, exact rational); WP P2-14 / decision D-l
